Hi maintainers,

I reproduced the issue on macOS Darwin with Python 3.12. The issue stems from the stdio pipe buffering before EOF. Passing flush=True in the event loop writer resolves the hang.

I have submitted PR #108 with the regression test.

Best,
Arya
